body:
#3981 round-1 fixes F1/F2/F3/F5 are pushed; new head c901aa5143a (one commit on the reviewed 20a51b7), ready for the scoped re-review. (Sent by mail because the advisor session aida-72 is no longer reachable by direct message.)

F1: a reviewer past its limit is excused only by a verdict recorded at or after its own start; the test with an older verdict at the head reaches the BLOCKED count. F2: log header (time, changes, head, base, merge tree or spec, command) written before spawn. F3: the cap counts Reviewing rows plus live Kind::Review children, deduped by PR. F5: record IO errors in the loop and the --once wait are reported and the run continues; nothing is launched until the unwritten record is on disk. F5 has no test (live loop only).

Checks: check-ci-fast 47 gates; dell1 1757 passed, 1 failed: gate::mandate expiry_mail_retries_failed_delivery_and_deduplicates_each_expiry, unrelated, passes 3 of 3 alone (flaky under load). JSON audit 14 passed.

Out-of-scope touches for the reviewer: gate/ledger/project.rs gains change_verdicts_checked (read-only; returns the ledger time with each record; the old name is a wrapper), scripts/store-writers.toml gains one entry.

Also: integration is at a0b7db7e63c (main 01b8e71 merged, sent earlier). I am back on BUG-2569.
subject: #3981 fixes pushed at c901aa5143a, ready for scoped re-review
